note: OMIM entries confirm SCA52 is an autosomal dominant disorder caused by heterozygous missense mutations in RAB3A.

evidence.text: In patients with spinocerebellar ataxia-52 (SCA52; 621535), Hengel et al. identified a heterozygous missense mutation in the RAB3A gene (I27T).

source.title: Entry - *179490 - RAS-ASSOCIATED PROTEIN RAB3A
source.quote: spinocerebellar ataxia-52 (SCA52; 621535), Hengel et al. (2025) identified a heterozygous missense mutation in the RAB3A gene (I27T; 179490.0002).

evidence.text: Spinocerebellar ataxia-52 is an autosomal dominant neurologic disorder characterized by gait and limb ataxia, nystagmus, and cerebellar atrophy.
